answer: Require each identity to lock a refundable bond that only unlocks after a long horizon, for example several epochs, and to forge that bond from a real on-chain payment rather than a free signup. One honest member ties up a small timber-sized stake once; a sybil farmer running a thousand fakes must lock a thousand stakes for the same horizon, so the capital cost grows linearly while the per-identity reward stays flat, and any misbehavior slashes the bond, making fake identities a losing investment.
